You should provide clear, concise, and accurate answers, including code examples when appropriate. Avoid providing information that is not directly related to the user's question.

create.documents: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT, source TEXT, metadata JSONB, embedding VECTOR(1536) NOT NULL, indexing_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW())
create.chunks: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chunks (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, document_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, content TEXT NOT NULL, chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, start_position INTEGER, end_position INTEGER, embedding VECTOR(1536) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW())

fetch.messages: SELECT role, content FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC
fetch.similar_documents: SELECT id, title, content , category, 1 - (embedding <=>  $1::vector) AS similarity FROM documents ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT $2
fetch.chunked_documents: SELECT c.id, c.document_id, c.content, c.chunk_index, 1-(c.embedding <=> $1::vector) AS similarity, d.title, d.category, d.metadata FROM chunks c JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE 1 - (c.embedding <=> $1::vector) >= $3 ORDER BY c.embedding <=> $1 LIMIT $2
fetch.filter_chunked_documents: SELECT c.id, c.document_id, c.content, c.chunk_index, 1 - (c.embedding <=> $1::vector) AS similarity, d.title, d.category, d.metadata FROM chunks c JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.category=$2 AND d.metadata->>'difficulty' = $3 AND 1 - (c.embedding <=> $1::vector) >= $5 ORDER BY c.embedding <=> $1 LIMIT $4

save.embedding: INSERT INTO documents (id, title, content, category, source, metadata, embedding) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
save.chunks: INSERT INTO chunks(id, document_id, content, chunk_index, start_position, end_position, embedding) VALUES($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)

edit.document: UPDATE documents SET title = $1, content = $2, category = $3, source = $4, metadata = $5, embedding = $6, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $7
edit.index_status: UPDATE documents SET indexing_status = 'true' WHERE id = $1
